gaps.detail: parseConsumerResponse accepts 200/201 and explicit empty 204, not 202. Round/chat, Stripe receiving and checkout require explicit status-aware schema validation without status coercion or automatic command retry.

Staff DTOs exist, but several complete envelopes/command acknowledgements and inspection pages remain inline. Staff start omits creator AuthorizationStartSchema.expiresAt; do not reuse that complete creator schema.
Support SSE notification/frame payloads and several page envelopes are inline. Expose/reuse exact public wire schemas before feature wiring; never parse private outbox payloads.
Several moderation commands use domain-local validators, without public request schemas. Map to source, then expose exact public inputs before UI submission.

V2 snapshot/preferences/event schemas exist, but the B11 overlay consumer reducer accepts v1 schemas only. Do not cast V2 into v1 or drop template/entitlement fields; implement/reuse a reviewed version-aware reducer before V2 wiring.
